articles.title_en: Strategic information avoidance, belief manipulation and the effectiveness of green nudges
articles.title_cn: 策略性信息回避、信念操纵与绿色助推的有效性
articles.abstract_en: Many behavioral nudges harness social or self-image concerns to promote environmental-friendly choices. Their effectiveness may be reduced if people maintain their desired image through information avoidance and belief manipulation which justify selfish actions. To test the conditions that induce information avoidance and belief manipulation, we conducted an online experiment on air conditioning (AC) usage involving over 2,000 US households. Combining requests of effortful behavioral changes, in terms of increases in AC temperature, with greater salience of a social norm of energy conservation discourages people’s acquisition of information on the impacts of AC and induces them to report beliefs that AC usage has low environmental impacts. Adding a costly behavioral change request to social norm salience fails to induce changes in AC thermostat settings. These findings are reinforced by field evidence from an energy conservation nudge: households avoid social information on their energy usage when high temperatures make AC use necessary. Our results highlight how context may trigger strategic information acquisition and motivated beliefs, potentially limiting the effectiveness of social norm nudges. The study emphasizes the need to tailor environmental policies to the context and to broaden their scope to deal with all possible behavioral responses.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多行为助推利用社会或自我形象关注来促进环保选择。如果人们通过信息回避和信念操纵来维持其期望形象，从而为自私行为辩护，这些助推的有效性可能会降低。为了测试引发信息回避和信念操纵的条件，我们进行了一项关于空调使用的在线实验，涉及超过2,000个美国家庭。将要求费力行为改变（即提高空调温度）与社会节能规范的显著性相结合，会阻碍人们获取关于空调影响的信息，并诱导他们报告认为空调使用对环境影响较低的信念。在社会规范显著性上增加一项代价高昂的行为改变要求，未能诱导空调恒温器设置的改变。这些发现得到了来自节能助推的现场证据的加强：当高温使空调使用成为必要时，家庭会回避关于其能源使用的社会信息。我们的结果强调了情境如何可能触发策略性信息获取和动机性信念，从而可能限制社会规范助推的有效性。该研究强调需要根据情境调整环境政策，并扩大其范围以应对所有可能的行为反应。

articles.title_en: Climate change and its impact on home insurance uptake in Australia
articles.title_cn: 气候变化及其对澳大利亚家庭保险购买的影响
articles.abstract_en: Climate change is impacting the frequency and severity of physical risks such as wildfire, flood, cyclone and extreme precipitation. This is changing both the costs and benefits of home insurance purchase for households—leading to uncertainty about future insurance uptake rates under climate change. We use disaggregated data for Australia on the likelihood of climate hazards, and household panel data, to model the relationship between insurance uptake and exposure to climate physical risks. This model is then used to project insurance purchase out to 2100 under three climate scenarios. We find that exposure to climate risks does influence the likelihood of purchasing insurance. While for most hazards higher risk reduces the likelihood of purchase, there are exceptions, and the relationship is often complex. Projections from our model indicate that insurance coverage is likely to decline relatively modestly, by around one percentage point across Australia from 2000 to 2100 as a result of climate change. However, we find there is significant variation across regions.
articles.abstract_cn: 气候变化正在影响野火、洪水、气旋和极端降水等物理风险的发生频率和严重程度。这正在改变家庭购买房屋保险的成本和收益，导致气候变化下未来保险购买率的不确定性。我们使用澳大利亚关于气候灾害可能性的分类数据和家庭面板数据，来模拟保险购买与气候物理风险暴露之间的关系。然后，该模型被用于在三种气候情景下预测到2100年的保险购买情况。我们发现，气候风险的暴露确实会影响购买保险的可能性。虽然对于大多数灾害，较高的风险会降低购买的可能性，但也有例外，且这种关系往往很复杂。我们模型的预测表明，由于气候变化，从2000年到2100年，澳大利亚的保险覆盖率可能会相对温和地下降，大约下降一个百分点。然而，我们发现各地区之间存在显著差异。

articles.title_en: On the inference about a willingness-to-pay distribution using contingent valuation data
articles.title_cn: 关于使用条件价值评估数据推断支付意愿分布的研究
articles.abstract_en: Although contingent valuation (CV) is one of the main sources of willingness-to-pay (WTP) estimates of environmental goods, little guidance exists regarding parametric approaches to modeling CV data, which could reliably estimate WTP values based on preferences stated in binary choice, payment card, and open-ended questions, among others. Studies that use parametric models of WTP often select a specification from a limited set of commonly used distributions. To improve the reliability of parametric modeling of CV-based welfare estimates, we propose adopting a more flexible approach that considers a broad range of specifications with varying parametric distributions. We demonstrate the advantages of the proposed approach using data sets from two large CV studies: the eutrophication reduction valuation study for the Baltic Sea Action Plan and the Deepwater Horizon natural resource damage assessment. We find that the best parametric specifications that fit the data differ across the two case studies. Moreover, these optimal specifications do not always align with most commonly used distributions. We further observe non-negligible differences in welfare estimates across the specifications. Our results provide tentative evidence that the variation in the estimates is lower when better-fitting specifications are considered. These findings emphasize the need for cautiously identifying the distribution best fitting to the data. Focusing on the best-fitting parametric specifications, we provide alternative WTP value estimates for the two empirical cases studied.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管条件价值评估（CV）是环境物品支付意愿（WTP）估计的主要来源之一，但关于参数化方法建模CV数据的指导很少，这些方法能够基于二元选择、支付卡和开放式问题等陈述的偏好可靠地估计WTP值。使用WTP参数模型的研究通常从一组有限的常用分布中选择一个规格。为了提高基于CV的福利估计参数化建模的可靠性，我们建议采用更灵活的方法，考虑具有不同参数分布的广泛规格。我们使用两项大型CV研究的数据集展示了所提出方法的优势：波罗的海行动计划富营养化减少价值评估研究和深水地平线自然资源损害评估。我们发现，最适合数据的参数规格在这两个案例研究中有所不同。此外，这些最优规格并不总是与最常用的分布一致。我们进一步观察到不同规格之间福利估计存在不可忽视的差异。我们的结果提供了初步证据，表明当考虑拟合更好的规格时，估计的变异性较低。这些发现强调了谨慎识别最适合数据的分布的必要性。专注于最佳拟合的参数规格，我们为所研究的两个实证案例提供了替代的WTP值估计。

articles.title_en: Beyond the haze: Decomposing the effect of economic inequality on global air quality from 2000 to 2020
articles.title_cn: 迷雾之外：分解2000年至2020年经济不平等对全球空气质量的影响
articles.abstract_en: Extant research has analysed the macroeconomic and political drivers of worldwide air pollution. Empirically, studies have focused on either between-country (cross-national comparisons) or within-country (temporal changes) dynamics, but these related effects have not been simultaneously addressed. Employing a comprehensive dataset spanning 156 countries over two decades (2000−2020), we take a distinctive dual approach to examine the effects of economic inequality, economic development, and democratic institutions on air pollution exposure within and across countries. First, against expectations, we find that within countries over time, increases in economic inequality correlate with reduced air pollution. This relationship remains consistent irrespective of country-level economic development or democratic status. Further we find that the trajectory of economic inequality conditions this effect, suggesting that whether redistributive measures towards addressing economic inequality carry environmental co-benefits or trade-offs likely depends upon the context. Second, between countries, economic inequality has a limited association with air pollution levels. Third, the effects of economic inequality on air pollution levels within and between countries are substantively small in comparison to the impact of economic development and democracy. This study emphasises the need to reconsider conventional expectations regarding economic inequality, further accentuating the influence of economic development and democratic institutions.
articles.abstract_cn: 现有研究已分析了全球空气污染的经济和政治驱动因素。实证上，研究要么聚焦于国家间（跨国比较）动态，要么聚焦于国家内（时间变化）动态，但这些相关效应尚未被同时处理。利用涵盖156个国家、跨越二十年（2000年至2020年）的全面数据集，我们采取独特的双重方法来考察经济不平等、经济发展和民主制度对国家内和国家间空气污染暴露的影响。首先，与预期相反，我们发现国家内随时间推移，经济不平等的加剧与空气污染的减少相关。无论国家层面的经济发展水平或民主状况如何，这一关系保持一致。进一步，我们发现经济不平等的轨迹调节了这一效应，表明旨在解决经济不平等的再分配措施是否带来环境协同效益或权衡，可能取决于具体情境。其次，在国家间，经济不平等与空气污染水平的关联有限。第三，与经济发展和民主的影响相比，经济不平等对国家内和国家间空气污染水平的影响在实质上较小。本研究强调需要重新考虑关于经济不平等的传统预期，进一步凸显经济发展和民主制度的影响。

articles.title_en: Sustainable practices in cocoa production. The role of certification schemes and farmer cooperatives
articles.title_cn: 可可生产中的可持续实践：认证计划与农民合作社的作用
articles.abstract_en: In Côte d'Ivoire and Ghana, many small-scale cocoa producers cultivate cocoa in unshaded or low-shaded plots, leading to challenges such as reduced biodiversity, soil fertility depletion, and increased soil erosion. To assess the adoption of sustainable agricultural practices in the cocoa sector, we develop a scale that incorporates dimensions of agroforestry, soil conservation, pest and disease management and farm sanitation. Using data from >1700 cocoa producers, we examine farmer participation in cooperatives and three main certification schemes (incl. Fairtrade, Rainforest Alliance and Organic) to understand their roles in promoting sustainable practices. We apply a multinomial endogenous switching regression model to control for potential selection bias and estimate the impact of participating in certification schemes, farmer cooperatives or both. In Côte d'Ivoire, econometric results show that joint participation in both a certification scheme and a farmer cooperative is associated with a significantly higher sustainability score. In Ghana, certification scheme membership shows the highest effect.
articles.abstract_cn: 在科特迪瓦和加纳，许多小规模可可种植者在无遮荫或低遮荫的地块上种植可可，导致生物多样性减少、土壤肥力枯竭和土壤侵蚀加剧等挑战。为了评估可可部门可持续农业实践的采用情况，我们开发了一个包含农林业、土壤保护、病虫害管理和农场卫生等维度的量表。利用来自超过1700名可可种植者的数据，我们考察了农民参与合作社和三个主要认证计划（包括公平贸易、雨林联盟和有机认证）的情况，以了解它们在促进可持续实践中的作用。我们应用多元内生转换回归模型来控制潜在的选择偏差，并估计参与认证计划、农民合作社或两者兼有的影响。在科特迪瓦，计量经济学结果表明，同时参与认证计划和农民合作社与显著更高的可持续性得分相关。在加纳，认证计划成员资格显示出最高的效果。

articles.title_en: Ecological footprint, resource security and semi-autarky
articles.title_cn: 生态足迹、资源安全与半自给自足
articles.abstract_en: Can the ecological footprint framework be used for measuring resource security? Wackernagel et al. (2021) assert it can, emphasizing the role of biocapacity balance – the difference between a country's biocapacity and the ecological footprint of its consumption. This paper argues that a positive biocapacity balance is not a good indicator of resource security, as it misrepresents climate change's relevance to national resources, overlooks resource depletion, and enforces an overly restrictive notion of “semi-autarky”. The paper suggests a set of guidelines to better capture resource security.
articles.abstract_cn: 生态足迹框架能否用于衡量资源安全？Wackernagel等人（2021）断言可以，并强调生物承载力平衡的作用——即一个国家的生物承载力与其消费的生态足迹之间的差异。本文认为，正的生物承载力平衡并不是资源安全的好指标，因为它歪曲了气候变化对国家资源的相关性，忽视了资源枯竭，并强制推行了一种过于严格的“半自给自足”概念。本文提出了一套指南，以更好地捕捉资源安全。

articles.title_en: Virtual water trade: Does bilateral tariff matter?
articles.title_cn: 虚拟水贸易：双边关税是否重要？
articles.abstract_en: Virtual water trade (VWT) is the trade of water ‘embodied’ in a product. This paper explores the extent to which bilateral tariffs, World Trade Organization (WTO), and Regional Trade Agreements (RTA) reshape the trade of water across nations and alleviate water scarcity issues. To achieve this goal, we built a panel database on blue (irrigation water) and green (rainwater) VWT among paired trading countries from 1998 to 2002. Using a standard gravity model, we study how the bilateral tariff and WTO/ RTA affect the intensity of blue and green VWT. The results indicate that, on average, a 1% tariff reduction increases the green virtual water trade by 0.219%. In most waterstressed countries, a 1% reduction in tariffs increased blue VWT by 0.416% and green VWT by 0.424%. By crops, we find that tariffs had a negative effect on VWT for the less water-intensive crops, but a positive effect or no effect on the more water-intensive crops. We further find in the most water-stressed countries, RTA facilitated VWT. As a climate mitigation strategy, water-scarce countries can increase VWT, thus reducing the production of water-intensive crops, by lowering tariff rates independently or through trade agreements.
articles.abstract_cn: 虚拟水贸易（VWT）是指产品中“隐含”的水的贸易。本文探讨了双边关税、世界贸易组织（WTO）和区域贸易协定（RTA）在多大程度上重塑了国家间的水贸易并缓解了水资源短缺问题。为实现这一目标，我们构建了一个关于1998年至2002年间配对贸易国家间蓝水（灌溉水）和绿水（雨水）虚拟水贸易的面板数据库。使用标准引力模型，我们研究了双边关税和WTO/RTA如何影响蓝水和绿水虚拟水贸易的强度。结果表明，平均而言，关税降低1%会使绿色虚拟水贸易增加0.219%。在大多数水资源紧张的国家，关税降低1%使蓝色虚拟水贸易增加0.416%，绿色虚拟水贸易增加0.424%。按作物分类，我们发现关税对水资源密集型程度较低的作物的虚拟水贸易有负面影响，但对水资源密集型程度较高的作物有正面影响或无影响。我们进一步发现，在大多数水资源紧张的国家，RTA促进了虚拟水贸易。作为一种气候缓解策略，水资源稀缺的国家可以通过独立降低关税税率或通过贸易协定来增加虚拟水贸易，从而减少水资源密集型作物的生产。

articles.title_en: Economic evaluations of urban green and blue space interventions: A scoping review
articles.title_cn: 城市绿色与蓝色空间干预措施的经济评估：一项范围综述
articles.abstract_en: While a number of studies have estimated the economic value of existing urban green and blue spaces (UGBS), few studies have attempted to value the impact of new UGBS interventions. We set out to identify primary studies in both peer-reviewed and grey literature that conducted economic evaluations of UGBS interventions, and to critically assess the methods and tools employed. We searched seven bibliographic databases to identify peer-reviewed studies, and grey literature was identified through a series of targeted searches on databases that included EVRI, Google Scholar, Social Value UK, New Economics Foundation, and OpenGrey. Study quality was assessed using adapted versions of the Drummond checklist and Krlev's quality assessment framework. Forty five eligible studies were included in the analysis; most were of medium quality (n = 27), and a large proportion (n = 22) used cost-benefit analysis. We observed inconsistencies in relation to the selection of benefits, use of discount rates, and sensitivity analysis, as well as a general lack of stakeholder input. Further, we identified a range of different instruments and evaluation techniques, but no clearly defined methodological framework that studies adhered to. Greater consensus is needed on the application of methodologies used to value UGBS interventions if evaluations are to remain credible and inform future investments.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管许多研究已经估算了现有城市绿色与蓝色空间（UGBS）的经济价值，但很少有研究尝试评估新增UGBS干预措施的影响。我们着手识别同行评审文献和灰色文献中开展UGBS干预措施经济评估的原始研究，并批判性评估所采用的方法和工具。我们检索了七个书目数据库以识别同行评审研究，并通过针对包括EVRI、Google Scholar、Social Value UK、New Economics Foundation和OpenGrey在内的数据库进行一系列定向检索来识别灰色文献。研究质量采用改编版的Drummond检查表和Krlev的质量评估框架进行评估。分析中纳入了四十五项符合条件的研究；大多数为中等质量（n = 27），且很大比例（n = 22）使用了成本效益分析。我们观察到在效益选择、贴现率使用和敏感性分析方面存在不一致，以及普遍缺乏利益相关者的参与。此外，我们识别了各种不同的工具和评估技术，但没有明确界定的方法论框架供研究遵循。如果评估要保持可信并为未来投资提供信息，就需要在用于评估UGBS干预措施的方法应用上达成更大的共识。

articles.title_en: Omitted downstream attributes and the benefits of nutrient reductions: Implications for choice experiments
articles.title_cn: 遗漏的下游属性与营养物削减的效益：对选择实验的启示
articles.abstract_en: Discrete choice experiments have been used extensively to value environmental quality; however, some important attributes are often omitted due to design challenges. In the case of quantifying the values of water quality improvement programs that bring transboundary impacts, existing studies predominantly focus solely on local benefits. Using a statewide survey of Iowa residents, we provide one of the first estimates of willingness-to-pay for both local and downstream water quality improvements-Gulf of Mexico hypoxic zone reduction-stemming from nutrient reductions. Using a split-sample design, we find that excluding hypoxic zone reduction as an attribute significantly reduces the total economic value of nutrient reduction programs. Moreover, we find evidence showing that such exclusion, in line with the theoretical prediction, only changes the preferences of respondents who are aware of the transboundary impacts of nutrient reductions. Conversely, our results also show that providing information about the downstream water quality benefits of nutrient reductions increases support for water quality improvement plans among local residents who are unaware of the connection between local and downstream water quality.
articles.abstract_cn: 离散选择实验已被广泛用于评估环境质量；然而，由于设计挑战，一些重要属性常常被遗漏。在量化具有跨界影响的水质改善项目价值的案例中，现有研究主要仅关注本地效益。利用爱荷华州居民的州范围调查，我们提供了首个估计之一，即对营养物削减带来的本地和下游水质改善——墨西哥湾缺氧区减少——的支付意愿。采用分样本设计，我们发现将缺氧区减少作为属性排除会显著降低营养物削减项目的总经济价值。此外，我们发现有证据表明，这种排除与理论预测一致，仅改变了那些意识到营养物削减跨界影响的受访者的偏好。相反，我们的结果还表明，提供关于营养物削减下游水质效益的信息，会增加那些不了解本地与下游水质联系的当地居民对水质改善计划的支持。

articles.title_en: Renewable energy and well-being in remote Indigenous communities of Canada: A panel analysis
articles.title_cn: 加拿大偏远原住民社区的可再生能源与福祉：一项面板分析
articles.abstract_en: Energy transitions in Indigenous, Northern and remote communities in Canada promise benefits that go beyond reliable, clean and affordable energy services. The Federal and Provincial governments have committed funding to get remote communities off diesel, acknowledging energy transitions' global and local benefits. Besides climate change mitigation, other benefits, including job creation, income generation, community ownership and local economic growth, are fundamental components of the value proposition of renewable energy projects. However, despite the promises, little evidence of the impacts of renewable energy on communities' local conditions exists. This article looks at the relationship between renewable energy projects and community well-being in Canada. We construct a panel of Indigenous communities and well-being levels using Census data and information about renewable energy projects for the period 1981–2016. The findings suggest that renewable energy is associated with higher levels of well-being. Concretely, having access to renewable energy increases overall well-being by 1 to 5 points on the 0–100 well-being scale, depending on the component of the well-being index considered in the analysis.
articles.abstract_cn: 加拿大原住民、北部和偏远社区的能源转型有望带来超越可靠、清洁和负担得起的能源服务的益处。联邦和省政府已承诺提供资金，使偏远社区摆脱柴油，承认能源转型的全球和本地益处。除了减缓气候变化外，其他益处，包括创造就业、创收、社区所有权和当地经济增长，是可再生能源项目价值主张的基本组成部分。然而，尽管有这些承诺，关于可再生能源对社区当地条件影响的证据却很少。本文考察了加拿大可再生能源项目与社区福祉之间的关系。我们利用人口普查数据和可再生能源项目信息，构建了一个原住民社区和福祉水平的面板，时间跨度为1981-2016。研究结果表明，可再生能源与更高的福祉水平相关。具体而言，获得可再生能源使总体福祉在0-100福祉量表上增加1至5分，具体取决于分析中所考虑的福祉指数的组成部分。

articles.title_en: The effect of the economic cycles on material requirements: Analysing the dematerialization in developed countries
articles.title_cn: 经济周期对物质需求的影响：发达国家去物质化分析
articles.abstract_en: The evolution of resource requirements in developed countries after the 2008 crisis seemed to indicate that there is a process of dematerialization. This paper analyses dematerialization in a group of developed countries and the effects of the economic cycle on resource use. The aim is to determine whether dematerialization can be linked to the effects of the economic crisis or, on the contrary, is independent of the economic context. To do this, a descriptive part is proposed in which the existence of dematerialization over the last 50 years is analysed. Subsequently, a model is estimated in which the effect of recessionary, low-growth and normal growth periods on the consumption of material resources is contrasted. The raw material input is used as an indicator of the use of material resources, which makes it possible to link each country to all the resources it requires for the normal functioning of its economy, regardless of where they are consumed. Among the main results, it can be noted that reductions in resource consumption occur in periods of recession and low growth, while for growth above 2% there is no dematerialization.
articles.abstract_cn: 2008年危机后发达国家资源需求的演变似乎表明存在去物质化过程。本文分析了一组发达国家的去物质化以及经济周期对资源使用的影响。目的是确定去物质化是否与经济危机的影响有关，或者相反，是否独立于经济背景。为此，提出了一个描述性部分，分析了过去50年中去物质化的存在。随后，估计了一个模型，对比了衰退期、低增长期和正常增长期对物质资源消耗的影响。原材料投入被用作物质资源使用的指标，这使得可以将每个国家与其经济正常运行所需的所有资源联系起来，无论这些资源在哪里被消耗。主要结果中，可以注意到资源消耗的减少发生在衰退和低增长时期，而对于超过2%的增长，则不存在去物质化。

articles.title_en: An assessment of the distributional impacts of autonomous adaptation to climate change from European agriculture
articles.title_cn: 欧洲农业对气候变化自主适应的分配影响评估
articles.abstract_en: Farmers facing a durable change in climate conditions may autonomously adapt through the intensive margin, the extensive margin, or through the adoption of new practices. Based on a coupling between a microeconomic model of European agriculture (AROPAj) and a crop model (STICS), this article investigates the potential distributional impacts of farm-level autonomous adaptation to climate change within the European Union (EU-27). Considering the representative concentration pathway (RCP) 4.5 of the second report on emission scenario of the fifth assessment report (SRES AR5), we implement two levels of autonomous adaptation for farmers, and three time horizons. The results indicate that ceteris paribus, climate change may lead in terms of social welfare to a slightly worse situation in the middle term and a slightly better situation in the long term with respect to the present. However, the ranking of agents in the distribution is importantly impacted. Our Shapley inequality decomposition shows that income inequality is largely explained by the region and type of farming. Climate change barely affects the marginal contribution of these two characteristics to overall income inequality.
articles.abstract_cn: 面临气候条件持久变化的农民可能通过集约边际、粗放边际或采用新做法进行自主适应。基于欧洲农业微观经济模型（AROPAj）与作物模型（STICS）的耦合，本文研究了欧盟（EU-27）内农场层面自主适应气候变化的潜在分配影响。考虑第五次评估报告（AR5）排放情景第二次报告中的代表性浓度路径（RCP）4.5，我们对农民实施两个水平的自主适应，并设定三个时间范围。结果表明，在其他条件不变的情况下，与当前相比，气候变化可能导致中期社会福利略差，长期略好。然而，分配中主体的排序受到重要影响。我们的Shapley不平等分解表明，收入不平等主要由地区和农场类型解释。气候变化几乎不影响这两个特征对总体收入不平等的边际贡献。

articles.title_cn: 节俭丰裕：去增长的概念化
articles.abstract_en: The concept of ‘frugal abundance’ has recently been mentioned in numerous degrowth publications and even presented as “the essence of degrowth” (Kallis et al., 2022, p.2). However, it has not yet been clearly conceptualised. The aim of this article is to start filling this gap. It provides substance to degrowth-compatible understandings of frugality and of abundance based on frugality, stressing the importance of the autonomous and pluriversal design of ‘enough’. It highlights that human material desires can be finite and satiated under some societal organisations and cultures. It also proposes a definition of a society of frugal abundance: it is a society in which everyone has a good life, consumption is low enough to achieve global ecological and social justice, and the material wants of everyone are satisfied. Through the notion of frugal abundance, the article argues that degrowth is associated with abundance, prosperity, richness, and it puts forth the term as a valuable addition to the conceptual and communication toolbox of the degrowth movement.
articles.abstract_cn: “节俭丰裕”这一概念最近在许多去增长出版物中被提及，甚至被呈现为“去增长的本质”（Kallis等，2022，第2页）。然而，它尚未被清晰地概念化。本文旨在开始填补这一空白。它为与去增长兼容的节俭观和基于节俭的丰裕观提供了实质内容，强调了“足够”的自主和多元设计的重要性。它强调，在某些社会组织和文化下，人类的物质欲望可以是有限的并得到满足。它还提出了一个节俭丰裕社会的定义：这是一个每个人都能过上美好生活、消费低到足以实现全球生态和社会正义、且每个人的物质需求都得到满足的社会。通过节俭丰裕的概念，本文论证了去增长与丰裕、繁荣、富足相关联，并将该术语作为去增长运动的概念和沟通工具箱中的宝贵补充提出。

articles.title_en: Possible carbon circular pathway exploration for oil transition under the consideration of energy supply constraint and uncertainty
articles.title_cn: 考虑能源供应约束和不确定性的石油转型可能的碳循环路径探索
articles.abstract_en: Addressing how to achieve carbon neutrality without hindering economic growth is critical. As the world's largest CO2 emitter and heavily reliant on imported crude oil, China faces challenges in shifting toward new energy sources to meet its 2060 carbon neutrality goal. This study introduces a novel decarbonized pathway for on-road fuel, considering economic and technological uncertainties. Our analysis reveals that achieving the 2060 target is improbable with the current energy structure trends, highlighting a potential energy crisis due to a growing oil demand gap. We assess the cost and economic feasibility of this new pathway compared to three major carbon neutrality approaches, finding that carbon substitution and capture pathways encounter significant sustainable development challenges. Our pathway suggests transferring and absorbing 20–25 Gt of CO2 from concentrated emission sources, offering a sustainable alternative by potentially reducing CO2 emissions by over 20–25 Gt through carbon circulation. This approach presents an economically viable solution, minimizing opposition from fossil fuel sectors. For a smooth oil sector transition to carbon neutrality, China needs stronger emission reduction policies and should enhance the new carbon‑hydrogen fuel's competitiveness through subsidies, both technologically and economically.
articles.abstract_cn: 解决如何在不阻碍经济增长的情况下实现碳中和至关重要。作为世界上最大的二氧化碳排放国且严重依赖进口原油，中国在转向新能源以满足其2060年碳中和目标方面面临挑战。本研究引入了一种新的公路燃料脱碳路径，考虑了经济和技术的不确定性。我们的分析表明，按照当前的能源结构趋势，实现2060年目标是不可能的，这凸显了由于日益增长的石油需求缺口而可能出现的能源危机。我们评估了该新路径与三种主要碳中和途径相比的成本和经济可行性，发现碳替代和碳捕获途径面临重大的可持续发展挑战。我们的路径建议从集中排放源转移和吸收20-25 Gt的二氧化碳，通过碳循环潜在地减少超过20-25 Gt的二氧化碳排放，提供了一种可持续的替代方案。这种方法提供了一种经济上可行的解决方案，最大限度地减少了化石燃料行业的反对。为了实现石油行业向碳中和的平稳过渡，中国需要更强有力的减排政策，并应通过补贴在技术和经济上提高新型碳氢燃料的竞争力。

articles.title_en: Assessment of the effects of extreme temperature on economic activity
articles.title_cn: 极端温度对经济活动影响的评估
articles.abstract_en: The effects of climate change on the economy are becoming increasingly evident. Based on information of all newly registered enterprises in China from 2000 to 2019, we discuss the relationship between heatwave and entrepreneurial activities at county level. Results indicate that extremely high temperatures can negatively affect entrepreneurial activities. Moreover, after considering endogeneity issues and conducting a series of robustness checks, the conclusion remains. In addition, mechanism testing shows that extremely high temperatures reduce the attractiveness of entrepreneurship by generating fiscal pressure effects, industrial dependence effects, and leading demonstration effects. Finally, heterogeneity analysis indicates that the adverse effects of extremely high temperatures will be alleviated in areas with large populations and high levels of education and healthcare. Different from the relief effect brought by the vigorous development of the secondary and tertiary industries, regions that rely more on the primary industry suffer more severe damage.
articles.abstract_cn: 气候变化对经济的影响日益显著。基于2000年至2019年中国所有新注册企业的信息，我们探讨了热浪与县级创业活动之间的关系。结果表明，极端高温会对创业活动产生负面影响。此外，在考虑内生性问题并进行一系列稳健性检验后，结论依然成立。进一步地，机制检验显示，极端高温通过产生财政压力效应、产业依赖效应和示范引领效应来降低创业吸引力。最后，异质性分析表明，在人口众多、教育水平和医疗水平较高的地区，极端高温的不利影响将得到缓解。与第二、第三产业蓬勃发展带来的缓解效应不同，更依赖第一产业的地区遭受的损害更为严重。

articles.title_en: Energy, urbanization, and complexity: Towards a multi-scale ecological economic theory of innovation
articles.title_cn: 能源、城市化与复杂性：迈向创新的多尺度生态经济理论
articles.abstract_en: The concept of innovation is at the core of any attempt to draft a meaningful theory of economic change. Whether by reducing innovations to the “myth of the sole inventor” or by adopting technological determinism, dominant narratives ignore the complexity of the socio-ecological relations underpinning patterns of societal transformation. This article proposes a framework grounded in critical realism and ecological economics to characterise innovations as elements endogenous to historical patterns of socio-ecological reproduction. Departing from Schumpeter's definition of creative response and Georgescu-Roegen's concept of exosomatic evolution, I discuss three main arguments: first, the relation between innovations and socio-economic change is impredicative, because the direction of causality cannot be clearly established; second, the emergence of innovations is bounded by declining marginal returns to economic complexity. Third, economic change has to be contextualised in relation to historical cycles of energy use and economic complexification. These arguments corroborate the hypothesis that a long-lasting S-shaped wave of innovation took place in capitalist economies over the past two centuries. This article has several implications for the study of both innovation waves and economic growth, in particular, by proposing a new framework to conceptualise productivity, energy, and labour as cornerstones of a multi-scale theory of innovation.
articles.abstract_cn: 创新概念是任何试图构建有意义的经济变迁理论的核心。无论是将创新简化为“唯一发明者神话”，还是采用技术决定论，主流叙事都忽视了支撑社会转型模式的社会-生态关系的复杂性。本文提出了一个基于批判实在论和生态经济学的框架，将创新视为社会-生态再生产历史模式的内生要素。从熊彼特的创造性回应定义和乔治斯库-罗根的体外进化概念出发，我讨论了三个主要论点：第一，创新与社会经济变迁之间的关系是不可预测的，因为因果方向无法明确确定；第二，创新的出现受到经济复杂性边际收益递减的约束。第三，经济变迁必须与能源使用和经济复杂化的历史周期相关联。这些论点证实了一个假设，即过去两个世纪中，资本主义经济体经历了一波持久的S形创新浪潮。本文对创新浪潮和经济增长的研究具有若干启示，特别是通过提出一个新的框架，将生产率、能源和劳动力概念化为多尺度创新理论的基石。

articles.title_en: Overhauling multinationals for the Anthropocene: How a rogue subsidiary offers a blueprint for sustainable development
articles.title_cn: 为人类世改革跨国公司：一个“叛逆子公司”如何为可持续发展提供蓝图
articles.abstract_en: This research addresses the question of how multinational enterprises (MNEs) can be overhauled to reckon with the finite ecosystem services that characterize the Anthropocene epoch. A comparative mechanism-based methodology is employed to seek an answer in the class of entities that MNEs are benchmarked against the unorthodox organization of a recently dubbed Unilever's “rogue subsidiary,” i.e., Ben & Jerry's, which could evolve into a turning point in sustainable development if replicated on a sufficient scale. The findings are that this subsidiary has put exceptional mechanisms to work, turning around functions that typically bolster the capabilities of MNEs to cash in on natural resources and other non-equity stakeholders. In a nutshell, these mechanisms 1) reduce the cost that stakeholders bear when engaging with MNEs across the value chain; 2) put the wardens of the company mission in charge of the organizational drivers of environmental and social commitments; 3) prevent the conflict of interests inherent in making wardens accountable to shareholders; 4) appoint key MNE executives in good faith consultation with wardens; and 5) secure wardens' recourse to the courts in the case of a breach of contract.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了如何改革跨国企业（MNEs）以应对人类世时代有限生态系统服务的问题。采用基于机制的比较方法，在跨国企业所对标的一类实体中寻找答案，即最近被称为联合利华“叛逆子公司”的Ben & Jerry's的非正统组织形式，若能在足够规模上复制，其可能成为可持续发展的转折点。研究发现，该子公司实施了特殊机制，扭转了通常增强跨国企业利用自然资源和其他非股权利益相关者能力的职能。简而言之，这些机制：1降低了利益相关者在价值链中与跨国企业互动时承担的成本；2让公司使命的守护者负责环境和社会承诺的组织驱动因素；3防止了守护者对股东负责所固有的利益冲突；4以诚信协商的方式，与守护者协商任命跨国企业关键高管；以及5确保守护者在违约情况下可诉诸法院。
